limitations: This is not a complete dynamic call graph, dependency proof, PHP AST, Laravel route:list or runtime authorization audit.
All source paths are relative to the four-repository parent. Source hashes normalize CRLF to LF; no timestamp, absolute path, environment or credential value is stored.
Scans all current PHP Models/Services/Domains/Jobs files; references include imports and lexical class symbols, not dynamic container, reflection, inheritance or callable resolution.
Schema operation lists include up/down/guard declarations and local literal assignment candidates; they do not describe the actual database state or prove migration reversibility.
Route candidates expand literal fluent group prefixes and collect middleware declarations; dynamic values, plugin registrations, reverse proxies and Workerman WSS require runtime verification.
Core candidates for Gateway operations are manually defined business correspondences checked against source declarations; behavior, credentials and payload equivalence are not asserted.
HEAD records identify committed baselines only. Working-tree sources may differ. Every invocation prints current dirty state; generated output never claims repositories are clean.
TX-Node-Installer is absent locally and is not inventoried. Installer behavior mentioned by other repositories remains unverified.

mcp.semantics: MCP forwards dedicated Agent Bearer to /txapi/agent/v1; Core Agent Ops is the authorization and approval authority. No direct DB/Redis/Node execution is inferred.

semantics.protocol: Native TXAPI node/v1 uses dedicated Bearer plus X-TX-Node-ID / X-TX-Machine-ID; Xboard panel compatibility is a separate adapter.
semantics.billingIdentity: ReportPayload.Traffic map[int][2]int64 and Core settlement still use user ID; no Subscription/Access Subject billing identity is established.
semantics.spool: One immutable pending batch, stable traffic_batch_id, file+directory fsync before sending; restart replays it; corrupt/unwritable spool fails startup. HTTP ACK clears the spool.
semantics.ack: Native PostReport accepts HTTP 202, protocol_version=1, accepted=true, matching batch ID and settlement=queued. Core NativeNodeReport ACK means queue dispatch, not SQL ledger commit.
semantics.settlement: TrafficBatchJob inserts tx_traffic_batch dedupe identity and applies tx_user / tx_server / statistics in one SQL transaction. A changed duplicate payload logs an error and does not reapply.
semantics.recoveryLimit: In-memory bytes before spool flush and permanent loss after queued ACK are not resolved by Node replay; B3 requires durable Core receipt and reconciliation.

semantics.boundary: Image-based Core installation and server lifecycle; not TX-Node installer.
semantics.health: Core retains /api/health for container/runtime liveness, separately from /txapi/health. Do not remove it during Gateway migration.
semantics.update: Preflight checks target ownership/schema; preserves verified backup; attempts migrations and checks migration status/snapshot/runtime health.
semantics.recovery: Before any migration attempt, updater can restart the old image. After migration may have changed DB, leaves service stopped and requires compatible backup/manual recovery; no general DB rollback.
semantics.restore: Interactive automatic restore is limited to managed local MySQL; host/external database restore uses database administrator tooling.
semantics.checkpoint: Upgrade phase/attempted_migrate variables are process state, not a durable resumable cross-component upgrade journal.
